review_state.title: Your Landing Page Isn't Underperforming. It's Asking People to Do Too Much.
review_state.description: Most landing pages don't fail on looks. They fail by asking visitors to make too many decisions. Here's the structure that actually converts.
review_state.preview_text: You spent good money sending people to a page, and most of them left without doing anything. The instinct is to blame the design — the colours, the hero image, the font. Usually that is not where the problem lives. A page that looks polished can still leak nearly every visitor if it asks them to make too many decisions at once.
